findings.evidence: Tensor.lean:102-108 defines `spinStructureTwo ε K := ε.bilinMap ![K.q, g K.p K.q • K.S - g K.S K.q • K.p]`; its only lemmas are `_apply`, `isAlt_`, `_apply_self`, `_conserved_left/right`, `_reverse`, `_neg`. `BilinMap.lean:92-122` adds only `neg` variants. Mathlib has `AlternatingMap.map_update_sub` and `map_update_smul` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Alternating/Basic.lean:163,173), so the lemmas are routine. Expanding the last slot gives `E₂ = (p·q)E₁ − (S·q)ε(·,·,q,p)`.
findings.fix: Add `spinStructureTwo_eq : spinStructureTwo ε K = g K.p K.q • spinStructureOne ε K - g K.S K.q • ε.bilinMap ![K.q, K.p]`, plus the corollary `g K.S K.q = 0 → spinStructureTwo ε K = g K.p K.q • spinStructureOne ε K`. This needs `AlternatingMap.bilinMap_pair_sub_snd` / `bilinMap_pair_smul_snd` in `Alternating/BilinMap.lean`, written exactly like the `bilinMap_pair_neg_snd` added here but over `map_update_sub` / `map_update_smul`.
findings.issue: No lemma relates `spinStructureTwo` to `spinStructureOne`, yet the module docstring asserts `E₂ = (p·q) E₁` at `S·q = 0` (line 58) and that `fromG1G2 = (M/(p·q)) ε(·,·,q, g₁S + g₂S_⊥)` (lines 190-191). Since `spinStructureTwo`'s body is not exposed, a consumer has only the pointwise `spinStructureTwo_apply` and must redo the `Matrix.vecCons`/`Fin.cons_update` footwork this PR needed for `bilinMap_update_neg` to split the last slot.

findings.evidence: `gWit_isSymm` exists for the parallel 3-D witness at Tensors/Basic.lean:973, and `kPol_M2`/`kPol_p_k`/`kPol_gammaSq` for `kPol` at Polarized/Kinematics.lean:300-318. `grep -c IsSymm` under `QFT/Scattering/DIS/` gives 61 hits across 6 files (Tensors/Basic.lean:32, Polarized/Kinematics.lean:12, …), all as hypotheses of the general lemmas. Tensor.lean:379-414 defines `ηWit`, `kWit4` with no symmetry or `Q2`/`xBj` lemma.
findings.fix: Add `lemma ηWit_isSymm : ηWit.IsSymm` and `@[simp] lemma kWit4_Q2 : kWit4.Q2 ηWit = 1`, `@[simp] lemma kWit4_xBj : kWit4.xBj ηWit = 1/2`, mirroring the 3-D witness.
findings.issue: The public witness `ηWit` / `kWit4` exposes only `ηWit_apply`, `kWit4_p/q/S/M2/p_q`. There is no `ηWit_isSymm`, and no `kWit4_Q2` / `kWit4_xBj` even though the `kWit4` docstring claims `Q² = 1` and `IsG1G2Decomposition ε kWit4 G W` evaluates `G.g1 (kWit4.xBj ηWit) (kWit4.Q2 ηWit)`. A witness exists to instantiate general theorems, and almost every general DIS lemma takes `hSymm : g.IsSymm`, so as shipped `kWit4` cannot be fed to them.

summary: The surface is minimal and free of compatibility artifacts, but two characteristic-API gaps remain: nothing relates E₂ to E₁ (a relation the module docstring asserts twice and consumers cannot derive without unfolding), and the new ℝ⁴ witness ships no `IsSymm` or kinematic-value lemmas, so it cannot instantiate the repo's general DIS API.
